description: CSS-only event block for <day-view>, <week-view> and the <calendar-wc> day detail: category colour, inline-start accent bar, half-hour placement. Multi-hour spans are positioned by the parent view's JavaScript.

attributes.name: data-category
attributes.description: Sets --event-color. Built in: meeting, deadline, personal, focus; any other value works with your own [data-category] rule.

attributes.name: data-start
attributes.description: Minute offset within the hour row. "30" places a single-hour event in the bottom half; day-view and week-view auto mode set it from the <time> when minutes >= 30.

attributes.name: data-duration
attributes.description: Length of a spanning event as hours and/or minutes, e.g. 2h, 45m, 1h30m, 90m. Read by <day-view>/<week-view> JS, which positions the event absolutely across hour rows. Unparseable values fall back to 1 hour.

attributes.name: data-date
attributes.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the event. Required for <week-view> auto mode, which places the event in that day's column; ignored by <day-view>.

structure.description: Start time label. The first <time datetime> is what day-view/week-view auto mode use to place the event; without one, day-view auto mode moves the event to its all-day list and week-view auto mode skips it.
Optional human-readable duration. Visually hidden, still read by assistive tech. Not used for positioning: use data-duration.
Put interactive content inside when the event is actionable; the block shows a pointer cursor and hover tint only then. The event element itself is not interactive.
